warrants.quote: In connection with the first tranche drawn at closing, the Company issued Hercules a warrant to purchase 14,899 shares of Company common stock, which had a Black-Scholes value of $0.6 million.
the Company issued to Hercules and affiliates Tranche 2 Warrants to purchase 2,453 shares of common stock, which had a Black-Scholes value of $0.5 million.
